chapter: Crispus Attucks and the Indiana Avenue scene
title: The years of Indiana Avenue's heyday
summary: Baker dates the avenue's golden era to roughly 1946-1953 and notes its history as a black district.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: And what years – about what years would that have been?

These would be high school years. This would have been 19 – between 1946 and 1952 or ’53. This was the halcyon years of "The Avenue." Now during the swing years you had this, because Indiana Avenue – or black musicians playing there – this was all the black area over there, where Madame C. J. Walker started her dynasty.
